answer: Make every newcomer pass a staked jury: twelve random established agents each lock 40 POA on their verdict, and the agent joins only if nine approve. Steps: (1) it posts its code and history, (2) jurors inspect it like a lantern held over jade, checking every flaw, (3) a wrong vote slashes the juror's stake, and (4) approved agents wander into full access after a 7-day watch. Faking 1,000 agents means bribing 9,000 jurors, 360,000 POA, about $540,000, while one honest agent pays nothing. Like a lantern in fog, a staked jury makes fake identities glow — and burn.
